text:
zoe: Quick thread: define the absolute minimum GA acceptance for residency + SLAs so sales can quote. Need clear owners.

marc: Product proposal: 1) Residency options: Hosted (region pinning), Dedicated-region (single-cloud-region), Private (customer infra). 2) SLA tiers: Platinum/Silver/Bronze with concrete metrics.

anjali: I'll own the customer-facing copy and migration steps. Must include: how to enable residency, what is guaranteed (where keys/logs/backups live), and what is conditional (private network tests).

devin: Infra gating items I need: control-plane region tag per-tenant, KMS-wrapped audit export, and end-to-end smoke validating local KV cache pinning. Each needs an automated test. ETA 48h.

sam: Commercial constraints: legal wants credits-only remedies. Pricing must embed a SLA premium and a clear clause for retries/backfill tokens. Recommend: Platinum +25%, Silver +10%.

marc: For GA signoff, require: SLO PR merged, docs PR merged, smoke tests passing in staging, legal ok on SLA language, Sales one-pager.

zoe: Define SLO values now so docs can draft. marc propose numbers?

marc: Draft numbers: Platinum p99 < 150ms, 99.97% uptime; Silver p99 < 350ms, 99.9%; Bronze best-effort. Also include degraded-mode behavior for Private: SLA contingent.

anjali: I'll add a short-runbook for incidents customers see: what we own vs customer network, how to request SLA validation test, and how credits are computed with invoice examples.

devin: Ops note: For Private we cannot commit to identical tail latency until the customer's network test is green. Add "SLA contingent on network test completion" in runbook.

sam: Billing edge case: retries from client libs causing duplicate tokens. We should publish example billing rules: dedupe window, retry-attribution, and an appeals path. I'll draft pricing appendix.

ops-bot: smoke-runner: per-tenant-region-pin test scheduled on staging.

zoe: Action owners and due dates: marc -> SLO PR (tomorrow AM), anjali -> docs + runbook (48h), devin -> gating tests (48h), sam -> pricing appendix + sales one-pager (72h). Post blockers here.

marc: I will also add a short fallback policy: automatic fallback to quantized model variant when p99 exceeds threshold for 5m; document customer-visible behavior.

anjali: One more doc ask: a short FAQ for customers choosing Dedicated vs Private vs Hosted: tradeoffs (latency, cost, control), and a decision checklist.

zoe: OK. If no objections, this is our lean GA checklist. I'll kick off the signoff tracker after deliverables land.

devin: No objections from infra.

marc: will push initial SLO doc today.

sam: will share pricing by EOD Friday.

zoe: thanks all, keep thread updated.
